Phase 0: Foundation & Installation.requirements: Portable skill installer, agent target paths, existing directory protection, force backup, rollback, manifest verification.
Phase 0: Foundation & Installation.safety_requirements: Zero modification of target project application code; never overwrite without backup; safe Unicode/spaces handling.
Phase 0: Foundation & Installation.remaining_limitations: Remote bootstrap disabled until canonical release package is officially approved.

Phase 1: Repository Intelligence.requirements: Evidence-based repo discovery, technology stack identification, file classification, monorepo support, Git baseline.
Phase 1: Repository Intelligence.safety_requirements: Strictly read-only; no subprocess execution of unknown code during file inventory.
Phase 1: Repository Intelligence.remaining_limitations: Deep framework dynamic dependency resolution limited to static heuristic patterns.

Phase 2: Maintenance & Presentation.requirements: Audit README and documentation, analyze unused files with framework awareness, assess license completeness and GitHub metadata.
Phase 2: Maintenance & Presentation.safety_requirements: Uncertain files are preserved; audit mode never modifies repository content.
Phase 2: Maintenance & Presentation.remaining_limitations: Draft documentation requires maintainer review before committing.

Phase 3: Security, Testing & CI/CD.requirements: Secret detection and redaction, static vulnerability patterns, dependency auditing, CI/CD workflow security, test readiness.
Phase 3: Security, Testing & CI/CD.safety_requirements: Full secret evidence masking (zero unmasked credentials in reports); tests run only when explicitly authorized.
Phase 3: Security, Testing & CI/CD.remaining_limitations: Vulnerability status marked UNVERIFIED when external CVE database is not locally mirrored.

Phase 4: Bounded Repair & Regression.requirements: Deterministic repair planning linked to findings, patch generation, pre-repair backup, bounded retries, regression validation, rollback.
Phase 4: Bounded Repair & Regression.safety_requirements: Autonomous rewrite blocked; changes strictly bound to approved patch manifest; automated backup before any modification.
Phase 4: Bounded Repair & Regression.remaining_limitations: Repairs bounded to static configuration and deterministic patterns.

Phase 5: Git Review & Conditional Publis.requirements: Git diff inspection, secret detection in staged diffs, staging approval manifest, commit approval manifest, fast-forward push approval.
Phase 5: Git Review & Conditional Publis.input_contract: inspect | plan-staging | stage-approved | plan-commit | commit-approved | inspect-remote | plan-push | push-approved | draft-pr
Phase 5: Git Review & Conditional Publis.safety_requirements: Zero autonomous commit or push; force-push and history rewriting strictly prohibited; independent staging, commit, and push approval gates.
Phase 5: Git Review & Conditional Publis.remaining_limitations: Requires target remote to support standard Git credential manager.

Phase 6: Integration, Compatibility & Re.requirements: Agent capability matrix, lifecycle handoffs DAG validation, artifact schema validation, release packaging, gate evaluation.
Phase 6: Integration, Compatibility & Re.safety_requirements: Read-only diagnostics guarantee; accurate agent support levels; byte-for-byte reproducible ZIP archives.
Phase 6: Integration, Compatibility & Re.remaining_limitations: Native multi-phase execution certified on Google Antigravity; other agents use adapter mappings.

Phase 7: Distribution & Post-Release Mai.requirements: Release validation gates, distribution package security (Zip Slip / secret scan), clean install testing, upgrade planning, post-release maintenance audit.
Phase 7: Distribution & Post-Release Mai.input_contract: inspect-release | validate-release | draft-release-notes | verify-distribution | test-installation | plan-upgrade | generate-maintenance-report
Phase 7: Distribution & Post-Release Mai.safety_requirements: Distribution verification enforces path traversal safety and unmasked secret prohibition; upgrade preserves backups.
Phase 7: Distribution & Post-Release Mai.remaining_limitations: Git tagging and public GitHub release creation require maintainer authorization.
